episodes.title: I Left Church for THIS! Why The Environment Was Toxic and Teaching HATE
episodes.description:
Leaving Mormonism was the only path forward after realizing the environment was actively hurting her mental health.

Full Video - https://youtu.be/Ot4rEm0mJGE

Jennie shares my personal story about walking away from church after a Sunday school class made it clear that the culture was not conducive to personal growth. This wasn't about a single bad day; it was an realization that the space I was in focused more on dogmatic control than learning to love others. If you have felt trapped by religious expectations or are struggling with the aftermath of leaving a high-control group, this conversation is for you.

Her decision to leave church for good was driven by the need for genuine healing and positive relationships. When an environment stops fostering healthy personal growth and starts feeling like insanity, it is time to reassess. Finding authentic peace often requires stepping away from spaces that do not value your well-being or your humanity.

episodes.title: From Trad Wife to Homeless: She Escaped 24 Years of Abuse
episodes.description:
In this powerful episode of The Mental Healness Podcast, domestic violence survivor and advocate Jennie Gage @lifetaketwo7662  shares how she escaped a 24-year abusive marriage and rebuilt her life from the ground up. Jennie discusses financial abuse, post-separation violence, religious trauma, a hidden double life, infidelity, trauma bonds, and the difficult reality of starting over with children after divorce. 

She also explains how therapy, education, community, and small acts of independence helped her move from survival mode to a safer and more fulfilling life. This conversation includes discussion of domestic violence, infidelity, and coercive control.

episodes.title: Reporting for CBS While Trapped in a Cult: The Peter Young Story
episodes.description:
How does a successful sports broadcaster spend 20 years inside a high-control religious cult? Peter Young joins @mentalhealnesspodcast to share the harrowing reality of "Uncle Robert"—a narcissistic leader who controlled his marriage, his family, and his mind for two decades.

Before his writing career, Peter was a sports broadcaster for over 20 years, telling the stories of athletes for networks like CBS, ESPN, and OLN. While his professional life blossomed, his private life was consumed by a "boutique cult" that specialized in coercive control and isolation. Now, Peter is using his professional voice to expose the dangers of small, family-based cults and help others find the path to recovery.

Connect with Peter Young:

Book: Stop the Tall Man, Save the Tiger: My Journey In and Out of a Cult
